findings.description: Hard house-rule breach. iso-24495-5/SKILL.md, rule 4, requires a named minimum presentation width for comparison tables and a read-back at that width. Without a named width, it requires repeated labelled records. The new Inventory and Exact identities tables at lines 19–24 and 28–31 have no named presentation width anywhere in the document.
findings.required_change: Replace both tables with repeated labelled records. Alternatively, obtain a minimum target width, name it, and record the required read-back. Preserve every boundary, wire identity, ownership statement, and support restriction.
findings.validation_command: mise exec -- mq --allow-http-import --no-lockfile -I raw -F raw 'import "github.com/harehare/okf.mq" | .' mise/conf.d/devtools-agent/bundles/creator/skills/web-design/references/source-metadata.md; manually inspect Inventory and Exact identities against iso-24495-5 rule 4.

findings.description: Hard house-rule breach. asd-ste100/SKILL.md, rule 1.14, requires American English spelling. The new referral says 'For authorised conversion'. 'authorised' uses British spelling. This prose is neither a technical identifier nor a quoted error.
findings.required_change: Change 'authorised' to 'authorized'. Preserve the link and separate conversion authority.
